C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER.IntentSummary: Deliver a minimal complete vertical from the topbar action center through immutable document intake, exact-object routing, conservative protocol merge, stable adaptive ranking, responsive UI and release regression evidence.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: define exact upload, processing, route and fallback states

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The flow saves the immutable source first, tracks the same documentId, opens the exact materialized object, preserves partial success and sends only ambiguity to review.

T-002.Title: kafedra-design: specify stable desktop and mobile hierarchy

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The rendered center has one primary upload affordance, three fixed recommendation slots, fixed groups, deterministic search, keyboard focus restoration and equivalent desktop/mobile completion paths.

T-003.Title: kafedra-motion: use restrained interruptible disclosure with explicit reduced-motion fallback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The center uses a short opacity/translation disclosure only for orientation, contains no routine bounce or full-screen animation, remains clear in static frames and removes animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

T-004.Title: kafedra-data: preserve immutable evidence and conservative meeting identity

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Protocol matching uses source identity or one exact number-and-date candidate, fills only missing values, keeps conflicts and evidence, creates no duplicate agenda item on retry and requires no schema change.

T-005.Title: kafedra-feature: implement registry, launch adapters, universal intake and exact-object routing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The existing topbar, calendar date action, manual-plan event listener and document worker are connected end to end without duplicating forms or materializers; action frequency is rank-only and server-allowlisted.

T-006.Title: kafedra-design-audit: independently verify implemented clarity, safety and responsive behavior

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Audit evidence verifies one clear primary path, stable geometry, source/progress visibility, preserved input on error, keyboard/focus, desktop, mobile and prefers-reduced-motion with no blocker or major finding.

T-007.Title: kafedra-tests: cover ranking, merge, exact route and degraded paths

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit and Playwright tests prove context precedence over frequency, three stable recommendations, exact day date, exact uploaded plan, conservative protocol merge, idempotent retry, desktop/mobile and reduced motion.

T-008.Title: kafedra-release: prove unchanged schema and offline dependency surface

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Version and schema remain unchanged, backup/restore and offline/release checks pass, and no CDN, cloud, mandatory LLM or runtime package dependency is added.
